article.title: Node.js 27 Alpha Arrives With V8 15.6 and a New Annual Release Cycle

sourcing.claim: Node.js 27 first alpha released October 29 2026 and includes V8 15.6
Heap limit behavior, serialization changes, keep-alive timeout and OpenSSL changes
Annual major releases, new alpha phase and all LTS roadmap

duplicate_prevention.limitations: Targeted search only; no transactional lock on global rotation cursor.

user_feedback.instruction: Captions should directly describe the image and provide source credit, without repetitive statements about what the image isn't.

cover_check.rotation: comic after previous anime; female after male

qa.WordPress_readback: publish, featured_media and three media images plus QR and captions confirmed

issues.resolution: Descriptive captions plus source attribution; passing post-save regex/order check

issues.reason: Web open and container DNS unable to fetch WordPress article and image URLs
A numeric release score was not persisted before publish; make this a hard state-machine gate next iteration

improvements: Use concise content-first captions; add regression script for negative-contrast phrasing and image/caption order.
Choose dated Gantt lifecycle rather than repetitive bars and persist schedule interval metadata with actual/planned distinctions.
Make prepublication signed-off score persist before publication; continue separately reporting backend confirmation and external live QA.
